name: vwap_mean_reversion_v18
mechanism: On NIFTY, sharp intraday selloffs push the index 40-80 spot points below session VWAP. At this deviation level, every VWAP-benchmarked institutional algorithm is sitting on large positive tracking error and begins aggressively accumulating — they are getting fills significantly better than their benchmark and are structurally compelled to buy. The accumulation shows up as a slowing in the rate of deviation change (dev_momentum turning positive) before price visibly recovers. We enter at the first bar where the z-score is still extreme (below -1.7 sigma of the session's deviation distribution) but momentum is already turning, capturing the onset of institutional re-entry rather than chasing after it.
core_signal_oneliner: VWAP z-score below -1.7 sigma with 2-minute deviation momentum turning positive, signaling onset of institutional re-accumulation
